The sorting implementation in `sort.ts` was analyzed for performance optimization. The original implementation uses a basic comparison-based sorting algorithm, which can be improved for better performance.

1. **Algorithm Switch**: Replaced the basic comparison-based sorting with a more efficient algorithm (Quicksort) which has an average time complexity of O(n log n).
